newsitem.title: UK: AMP seeks to buy UK life/pensions firm-FT.
newsitem.headline: AMP seeks to buy UK life/pensions firm-FT.

text.p: Australia's AMP is looking to buy a sizeable British life and pensions company as it seeks to double in size in Britain during the next five years, the Financial Times reported on Monday.

The newspaper quoted AMP's global merger and acquisition activity head, Jonathan Schwartz, as saying Britain would be used as a platform to expand in Europe. He said the group had about three billion pounds ($5.04 billion) to spend on global expansion.
The newspaper said AMP wanted to expand organically and by acquisition, and in particular aimed to gain more high-wealth customers.
"We want to double our AB customers from 250,000 within three years," Schwartz said.
